data.question: How many distinct customers (people) bought from the furniture_decor category?

steps: Join customers, orders, order_items, products, and category_translation to link customers to the English product category name 'furniture_decor'.
Count the distinct customer_unique_id for customers who purchased items in that category without filtering out canceled orders unless specified.

args.purpose: Count distinct customers (people) who bought from furniture_decor category
args.sql:
SELECT
  count(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation AS t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'furniture_decor'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
